title: Faster Happy Ghast for 1.20.1 (Alessandra15204)
description: Happy ghasts are 3 times faster in 1.20.1 (Vanillabackport is required)
body:
1.20.1 Happy Ghasts (from the Vanilla Backport mod) are now three times faster! ([vanilla backport](https://modrinth.com/mod/vanillabackport) is required) This change  increases the base speed to 0.15 from 0.5. Be sure you’re running [vanilla backport](https://modrinth.com/mod/vanillabackport) .


a big thanks to the VanillaBackport team for making this possible :3
